hypotheses.title: Supply Chain Customer Return Spillover Momentum (pv13)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Information diffuses gradually across complex economic supply networks. Customer firms experience revenue and demand shocks first; suppliers' stock prices lag behind by several trading days because market participants fail to price customer linkages in real time. Decaying customer return signals over a 10-day window captures this lead-lag drift with 93% continuous matrix coverage.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails during supply chain disintermediation where suppliers lose major accounts despite strong customer equity performance.

candidates.expression: cust_sig = ts_decay_linear(pv13_custretsig_retsig, 10); signal = group_rank(cust_sig, subindustry) - 0.5; group_neutralize(signal, subindustry)

hypotheses.title: Analyst Revision Price-Lag Underreaction (model16)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Exploits institutional underreaction to sell-side revisions. When consensus analyst revisions are aggressively upgraded (rev_rank is high) but the underlying equity price has lagged over the trailing month (px_rank is low), the market has not yet priced in the earnings inflection. Long the underreacting upgraded equities and short overbought downgraded equities.
confounders: Unscheduled guidance cuts immediately following analyst target increases
hypotheses.falsification_test: Underperforms during speculative rallies where heavily downgraded, low-quality equities surge on short-squeeze dynamics.

candidates.expression: rev_rank = group_rank(analyst_revision_rank_derivative, subindustry); px_rank = group_rank(ts_delta(close, 20) / close, subindustry); signal = rev_rank - px_rank; group_neutralize(ts_decay_linear(signal, 5), subindustry)

hypotheses.title: Options Volatility Panic Term Structure Reversion (option8)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: When 30-day implied volatility rank exceeds 90-day implied volatility rank within subindustry, options markets are in acute event panic (backwardation). Once headline fear peaks and implied volatility crushes, the underlying equity experiences powerful mean-reversion. Ranking both terms eliminates unit mismatches and ensures balanced weights.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Breaks down during structural default events where short-term volatility correctly anticipates bankruptcy.

candidates.expression: panic_spread = group_rank(implied_volatility_mean_30, subindustry) - group_rank(implied_volatility_mean_90, subindustry); group_neutralize(ts_decay_linear(panic_spread, 5), subindustry)
